$comment: Guardrails for the unattended weekly article run (scripts/weekly-article/).
On 2026-08-12 an unattended run drove AppleScript against a live Microsoft Word
session to test watermark survival, hit the wrong document, and removed files
belonging to an unrelated project. A prompt asking it not to would not have
stopped that; a deny rule does. These apply to any Claude session started in
this repository, so an interactive session is bound by them too.
PATHS ARE WRITTEN ~/... AND NOTHING ELSE. Not style -- measured.
~/Projects/**        runs, and denies          <- the only form that does both
//Users/ece/...      HANGS: headless `claude -p` emits the Read and never
gets a result. 3 runs of 3, deterministic. It cost four
days of lost articles and a full day of hunting: three
ceilings raised, a 7h39m orphaned model process, and a
false 'the CLI hangs during startup' alarm, before an
A/B on this file alone pinned it.
/Users/ece/...       runs, and silently DENIES NOTHING. A single leading
slash reads as relative to this directory and matches
nothing: a test read of ~/Projects went straight through
and a Glob of ~/.ssh came back with the names of five
private keys. The dangerous one, because it looks fixed.
Read(...) alone. NOT Glob or Grep: the CLI refuses those rules on startup --
"Glob(~/.aws/**) is not matched by file permission checks -- only Read(path)
rules are" -- and a Read rule already covers every file-reading tool. Adding
them printed a warning per rule and protected nothing extra.
The deny list is why this repo lives in ~/Sites and not ~/Projects: deny rules
beat allow rules and a broad pattern cannot carve out an exception, so a repo
inside a denied tree fences itself out. That happened on 2026-08-15 and cost a
run. scripts/weekly-article/install.sh now refuses to install from a path these
rules deny, so the same mistake cannot be made silently again.
NO `Bash(git push:*)` DENY since 2026-09-24. The article pipeline moved to a Claude
Code cloud routine (scripts/weekly-article/prompts/cloud-routine.md), and cloud
sessions obey this file, so the rule would stop the routine from pushing its
claude/article-* branch. Publishing is still gated: only a human merging the PR
reaches main.
